optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Customer Ticketing System
professionalSummary: Experienced delivery coordinator with two years managing enterprise implementations, maintaining project plans, leading status calls, escalating risks, and producing close‑out reports.
experienceHighlights: Maintained implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer‑facing status page current each week.
Prepared and hosted weekly customer status calls, recording decisions and actions.
Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with recommended options.
Drafted close‑out reports from action logs and call minutes, listing limitations and hand‑over items for customer support.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Action log export and close‑out report for one implementation, with project tool record identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in plan maintenance, status calls, risk escalation, and close‑out reporting, but do not explicitly confirm ownership of the entire implementation project or holding go‑live sign‑off.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Delivery Project Coordinator role.

role.roleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Customer Ticketing System

evidence.text: Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager.
evidence.notes: Shows escalation and go‑live sign‑off but not ownership of entire project.

missingEvidence: Evidence that the candidate owned the implementation project end‑to‑end and was the single accountable person for the project towards the customer.

evidence.text: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week.
evidence.notes: Directly supports plan, log, and schedule maintenance.

evidence.text: Prepared and hosted the weekly customer status call for my assigned implementations, recording decisions and actions; scope and commercial questions on the call were answered by the delivery manager.

Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager.
Drafted the close-out report for each implementation from the action log and the call minutes, listing open limitations and the hand-over items for customer support.
